secrets.name: The Kitchen
secrets.text: Behind the service door the kitchen is still working: the stove lit, the pans hot, a roast half carved on the board. Whoever was cooking has only just stepped out, and has been only just stepping out for a very long time.

meta.label: The Banquet
meta.blurb: A table laid for sixty, down the whole length of the hall; the candles are lit, the food is hot, and every chair has been pushed back from it. You have missed something. You are always just missing it.
